subject: VALUE clause
notes: kb/Work PB550, LANDED (wave 58). "The VALUE clause shall not be specified in a data description entry that contains a REDEFINES clause or in an entry that is subordinate to an entry containing a REDEFINES clause" (cite --check OK, §13.18.63.3 12)). DataBinder.ValuePlacement is the ONE placement screen (COBOL2406), asked in BindEntries the moment an entry is attached, over the entry's ancestor chain and keyed on the WRITTEN clause (RedefinesTargetName) - never the storage fact, so an FD's implicit redefinitions and a SAME RECORD AREA record are not its subject. Every shape the rule names is refused at every edition: the same-entry arm at levels 05 and 01, a subordinate at any depth, and a group-level VALUE on the redefining entry. Before: all compiled clean and the redefining entry's VALUE was DISCARDED (a REDEFINES view never seeds the storage it shares with its anchor). Over-rejection controls pinned: the redefined anchor's own VALUE, a REDEFINES entry with no VALUE, a level-88 under it (format 3 - SR24 does not import SR12), and a later non-subordinate sibling all compile (85/pb550_redefines_value_placement).
